name: zec-yield-orchestrator
description: Oilskin — a chain-agnostic, ZEC-holder-centric DeFi app. Base module: cbBTC, WETH or cbZEC as collateral on Aave v3 (or a Morpho Blue cbZEC/USDC market), borrow USDC, deploy it into Aerodrome liquidity, every position owned by the user's own smart account. Solana module (designed, not built): bridged ZEC on Kamino's ZCASH market, USDC borrowed, the same ladder run by an Anchor program + PDA the user's wallet owns. A loan never crosses a chain.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @zyo/shared && npm run build -w @zyo/agent && npm run build -w @zyo/yield && npm run build -w @zyo/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @zyo/agent && npm run test -w @zyo/yield && npm run test:contracts
